items.requirement: Observable outcomes, content, practice, assessment, and evaluation target the same performance level.
Content and scenarios trace to current approved sources.
Instructions, navigation, feedback, recovery, pacing, and chunking support the intended audience.
The module uses the approved profile and avoids unnecessary duplicate narration and on-screen text.
Keyboard, focus order, screen-reader semantics, contrast, alt text, captions, transcripts, zoom/reflow, and interaction alternatives were tested as applicable.
The approved interoperability package was tested in the actual target LMS for launch, completion, score, time, resume, and error behavior.
Version, reporting, privacy, support, rollback, owner, and review trigger are recorded.
